eps.ov: Ryoga challenges Ranma, but Ranma's battles with Cologne have made him far stronger. When Cologne appears before the vengeful Ryoga, what is her motive?
Akane tags along for Ranma's training, while Ryoga works to master the deadly "The Breaking Point." How will their clash unfold when Akane gets involved?
The Tendo family hits the beach. As Happosai runs wild, Ranma tries to set him up with Cologne — but it seems they share a past tied to an heirloom.
A man on a wild horse grabs Ranma. The culprit: Sentaro, heir of the Daimonji School of Martial Arts Tea Ceremony. A fierce succession battle begins!
Akane and Kodachi battle over homemade cookies. As Ranma chases after Kodachi and the stolen treats, Gosunkugi secretly snaps a compromising photo.
Ranma fights over a secretly taken photo with Kodachi, while Akane begins to suspect her scheme. Can Ranma get the photo negative and destroy the proof?
Ryoga tells Ranma he will soon part with P-chan after finding a map to the Japanese Spring of the Drowned Man — but it leads to the girls' locker room?
